token.title: 🔑 Otokeni yaGitHub
token.intro: GitHub ohayi yamukula omaindilo 60 mowili koadresa ndjoka kaayi tumu otokeni. Omuti aguhe gwoofork ohagu pula omaindilo ga thika po 32, onkee etalelo etiyali olya hulitha. Otokeni ohayi londeke ongamba sigo 5000 mowili.
token.step1: Egulula Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, e to hogolola Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner (omwene gwoshiyemo): akaunda yoye mwene. Expiration (ethimbo lyokuhula): esiku kehe, omuti kagu pumbwa sha shoka tashi kala ethimbo ele.
token.step4: Efa oompito adhihe dha fa ngaashi dhi li. Meta yiigandhi yaayehe kayi pumbwa nando yimwe yomudho.
token.step5: Shita, e to kopa ongushu yo {token}. GitHub ohayi yi ulike lumwe owala.
token.classic: Otokeni yonale oyi li nawa wo: shita yimwe kaayi na omukunda gwa hogololwa. Omukunda kaagu na sha ohagu lesha natango omauyelele gaayehe pondondo yomuntu a koshokwa.
token.stays: Otayi kala mombrowsa ndjika kohi yoshipatululi {key} noyi ha yi owala ku {host}. Ihayi nyolwa nando mehala lyoadresa, onkee ekwatathano ndyoka to topola otali humbata eulikilo, kali humbata omauyelele gokwiishiwa. Okakonopo kohi yehala lyokunyolela otaka yi dhima po we pamwe nokashe.
token.persistHow: Tula otokeni mofaela {env} yoseva ndjoka tayi humbata epandja ndika, popepi na {port}:
token.proxy: e to yi tameke no {make}. Okontena ohayi nyola okatopolwa kanginx haka kwatitha omutse {header} komukalelipo {path}, opo ombrowsa yi ithane onzo yayo yene nokayi pewa nando otokeni. Ehala ndika lyokunyolela ohali kana, naatalelipo ayehe ohaya topola obajeta yimwe yo 5000 mowili.
fork.refused404: Kaku na oondjila dhiitayi: {message}. 404 mpaka otashi ti oshitayi shoka kaashi po, nenge ondjila ndjoka omukalelipo gwoseva ihagu yi humbata; ekwatathano lyoofork pombanda olya gwana nokuli.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub ya hulithwa omaindilo mowili nguka, onkee kapu na oondjila dhiitayi dha vula okuthanekwa. Ekwatathano lyoofork pombanda olya gwana. Gwedha otokeni mopanela yoshihogololi, nenge dhima oondjila dhiitayi mopanela yomuthaleko opo obajeta yi longithwe owala mekwatathano.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub ya yamukula {status} kondjokonona yoocommit, onkee kapu na oondjila dhiitayi dha vula okuthanekwa. Ekwatathano lyoofork pombanda olya gwana.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Oshindhindhiliko kashi na esiku, onkee kehe shimwe sha thigala nosha kala sha pumbwa eindilo, na shoka sha thigala mowili nguka kashi longithwa ko.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, ekende lyoocommit niindhindhiliko ya etwa. Oondjila dhoofork dhoonale dhi vule ndjoka odha kwatelwa kombinga yolumoho.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Egulula oshigandhi opo u thaneke oondjila dhoocommit nomahanganitho gasho; oshikondo shethimbo ohashi ka kala owala kondjokonona ndjoka.

bond.help: Okuza komusholondo sigo kekolomona pombanda, okuza kekolomona sigo komusholondo pevi. Ekangitho lya 0 olyo epandja, 1 oshinima sha ikanena nalyo. Okupitila pombanda ohaku ulike ekondo mombala yoyela, okuthiminika ohaku li kwatelele mombala yoviola sigo wa thiminika we. Okulesha owala; longitha CLI yinfinito bond opo u lundulule.
